metadata.name: loop-design-check
metadata.description: Design a goal-oriented agent loop or review one for failure modes: spinning, Goodhart-gaming the verifier, or running a wrong answer to completion. Covers machine-decidable goals, loop types, plan/build/judge skeletons, and runaway prevention; mechanism wiring lives in autonomous-loops. Use when designing, writing, or checking an agent loop. 中文触发：写 loop、设计 loop、做一个 loop、检查 loop 对不对、loop 体检、loop 会不会跑飞、可判定目标、五个崩法、plan build judge。
